checks.scope: See VALIDATION.md and Actions evidence. This source archive contains no generated GUI/core binaries.

editor_check.worker: C++ latest-request worker, JSON receiver and generation/revision guarded GUI acceptance
editor_check.publication: generation and revision guarded; no automatic preview-MDX writes
editor_check.errors: swap default foreground/background; structured diagnostics; CP932 byte columns to UTF16 spans

pdx_edit.startup: MUS directory; existing PDXEDIT first, otherwise import matching PDX; otherwise blank project
pdx_edit.pcm: EXE/PDX-stem; existing destination confirmation; No selects another folder; Cancel aborts import
pdx_edit.project_and_output: MUS directory, independently of PCM folder
pdx_edit.overwrite: PDX convert confirmation; separate project target confirmation; current project autosave preserved
pdx_edit.import: manual import keeps configured PDX/project name and project directory; startup or empty name uses source basename; PCM folder uses source basename
pdx_edit.autosave: 2s idle; save reentry guard; pause during modal/load/import/convert; No or write failure blocks automatic retries until next edit; explicit close-save can retry

mrl_export.pdx: embed if located; absent bank retains PCM operation log
mrl_export.mrz: single record.mrl member, ZIP64/DEFLATE; bounded memory staging
mrl_export.controls: shared VGM export job progress/pause/cancel/overwrite; publish only complete output

selection_playback.boundary: all selected tracks have ended; longest step count including rests
selection_playback.state: restore excerpt sequencer context each cycle; monotonic chip time; preserve live settings
selection_playback.scope: interactive selection playback only; exports remain unchanged
selection_playback.initial_rest: only tracks whose first source-level MML command is r; pre-selection rests before first note; selected rests not duplicated; delay repeats each loop

gutter.toggle: right button up in line-number/step area
gutter.length: 192 steps/bar; compact whole bars (1b+4); slash-separated tracks; zero as 0
gutter.representation: exact integer dotted durations and divisors of 192; minimum terms; precomputed remainder table
gutter.mouse_routing: SS_NOTIFY STATIC; WM_NCHITTEST returns HTCLIENT; existing right-button handler toggles without editing text

icon.window: HIcon and HIconSm loaded using system large/small sizes; LR_SHARED

licensing.icon_provenance: assets/README.md; OpenAI image generation and assembly; 0BSD to extent copyright applies

licensing.bridge_runtime_notice: THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt: inherited Zig 0.13.0 notices including MinGW-w64 COPYING and per-file notices
